dedupe_keys.name: smartnialmeter swiss household and appliance electricity series

description: SmartNIALMeter records aggregate and appliance-level electricity in twenty Swiss homes around Zurich, Bern and Lucerne. The project combines smart-meter totals with dedicated measurements for one hundred appliances, including heat pumps and electric-vehicle charging, for up to two years at five-second resolution. Zenodo supplies raw and preprocessed HDF5 collections in 7Z archives, free under CC BY 4.0. The companion MIT-licensed Python workflow documents missing-power calculations, invalid-value removal and time resampling. Coverage varies by building and appliance, so the release is not a common continuous two-year panel. Cleaning removes rows and alters timestamps; raw and preprocessed versions should not be treated as identical observations. A reviewer-assessed use is deriving flexible-load components or testing disaggregation assumptions for household-energy simulations. data-refit-smart-homes-uk provides a related collection from another country. No HDF5 archive or preprocessing code was downloaded or executed.
